display_name: 已完成24个多解耦模型：即时独立10视图测试
description: 用户2026-10-10要求训练完成的立即测试。固定09:49源完成快照24行，独立输出，不改变剩余训练或原控制器。
authorization: 用户：训练完的进行测试，给出测试集结果。

data.representation: equalized=1; center256; unit packet RMS; fs=25000000Hz
data.tx_sets_ref: ManySig.tx_list: all6; actual physical class strings exported at runtime

roles.U_use: Own EMA old batch-neighbor pseudo CE and full-U entropy from E131

data.leo_config_ref: Unchanged native practical3 concat; source diagnostic clean/practical_mid; final frozen clean+six practical+three LEO_WEAK views

permissions.query_use: Frozen per-packet Phase1 inference only; separate truth-last scorer
permissions.claim_scope: Frozen-source auxiliary diagnostics and fixed scratch identity comparison; previously exposed proxy benchmark, not new blind/physical satellite evidence

checkpoint.initialization: No training; load each original scratch E200 checkpoint
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Recheck each source completion/init/config/mechanism and actual checkpoint before query
checkpoint.selection_rule: All24 completed at fixed snapshot; no metric-based selection

execution.gpu_policy: <=4 total experiment processes/GPU including CUDA and pre-CUDA; shared capacity lock and stable worker checks; >=12GB free; preserve other healthy runs
execution.stop_rule: Only affected technical failure; retain artifacts, no automatic retry, fallback or low-performance stop. No interventions on healthy existing jobs.

metrics_plan.primary: Four model seeds mean/sample SD and paired deltas; accuracy/F1/worst RX; six-view mean paired effects; all negative results retained
metrics_plan.desired_gain: six-view mean >=+2pp; clean drop<=.5pp; no systematic worstRX decline; >=3/4seed same direction. Scientific aim, not stop or tuning gate.
metrics_plan.resource_limits: Shared-GPU wall time and per-process CUDA peak; no isolated speed claim. Source RSS/FLOPs N/A. Phase2 K/adaptation/new TX/H/transfer N/A.
